summary: Tech sell-off persists into the last hour: SOX ~-6%, AMD ~-10%, 10-year above 5% after hot annual PPI; Nasdaq readings range -1% to -1.5%. Since 11:50: NVDA put trimmed 58->56 on a report of it paring to ~-2% around 3 PM ET; everything else unchanged (no fresh quotes).

picks.name: Nvidia
picks.reason: Down 2-4% on the CEO exit and HSBC downgrade, with signs of paring losses late; under 158 extends toward 155, back over 166.2 the put is wrong.

picks.name: Advanced Micro Devices
picks.reason: Hit the 553 put target, now down ~9% leading the chip rout; levels rolled to the ~523 intraday low, but the move is stretched so bounce risk trims confidence.

picks.name: Palo Alto Networks
picks.reason: KeyBanc upgrade plus a security bid from the Microsoft outage, but the deepening Nasdaq sell-off makes holding gains harder.

picks.name: Microsoft
picks.reason: Outlook outage plus a weak Nasdaq tape; under 505 extends, reclaim of 521 kills the put.

picks.name: Cerebras Systems
picks.reason: Earnings beat, raised guide and Microsoft deal, but a 5% SOX drop pressures AI chip names; under 112 the gap fails.

picks.name: Cisco Systems
picks.reason: Selling the news on its FQ1 beat; under the 97.70 low extends toward 96, back over 100.8 the fade fails.
